_comment: Electron Builder configuration for the Server installer. Identical to the build block in package.json except for the icon set and the artifact name: the brief ships the Server and the Client as separate installers with separate icons, and the installer records which one it laid down in install-config.json so the app knows whether it may open the database. Generated by hand from package.json rather than by a script, because these three files are read by electron-builder and a generator that quietly rewrote them would change a build without a visible edit.
